name: Tales From The Shadows
source:
Tales From The Shadows is an adult dark fantasy visual novel spinoff of Love MorteM.

In it you will play a young man, who has a peculiar family that he hardly knows, since his mother has been trying to keep him and his sister away from that family environment.

Unfortunately for Angela (his mother), he has gotten into trouble and must turn to his family.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
Tales From The Shadows是一部成人黑暗奇幻视觉小说，是Love MorteM的衍生作品。

在其中，你将扮演一个年轻人，他有一个他几乎不知道的特殊家庭，因为他的母亲一直试图让他和他的妹妹远离那个家庭环境。

不幸的是，对于安吉拉（他的母亲）来说，他遇到了麻烦，必须向家人求助。

[来自Itch.io]
